edus.text: Mr. Speaker, I beg to propose: That this House, in accordance with paragraph 8 (3)(a)(iv) of the Financial Procedures Act 1957 [Act 61],
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: taking a resolution agreeing that the Malaysian Government through the Minister of Finance (Incorporated) make an investment by changing the remaining Malaysian Government loan of RM165,282,814.00 to UDA Holding Berhad (UDA), a company fully owned by the Minister of Finance (Incorporated ) to equity ( stock capital ) equivalent to One Hundred Sixty Five Million Two Queens Eightty Two Thousand Eight Fourteen Queens ( 165,282,814 ) ordinary stock units at a value of RM1 for a stock unit presented before this Council.'
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, I would like to propose a motion for this House to take the resolution as I have mentioned that the Malaysian Government through the Minister of Finance (Incorporated) make an investment
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: by changing the Malaysian Government loan of RM165,282,814.00 to UDA Holding Berhad (UDA), a company owned by the Minister of Finance (Incorporated) to equity in UDA equivalent to RM165,282,814.00 ordinary stock units at a value of RM1 for a unit of stock.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, in accordance with the provisions under paragraph 8(3)(a)(iv) of the Financial Procedures Act 197 [Act 61],
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: the Minister of Finance can make money investment in the Federal credit position with any bank or other than it is held by the Federation
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: after being allowed by the Dewan Rakyat resolution.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Accordingly, the approval of this honorable House is requested to enable the Malaysian Government to make investments in UDA by changing the status of the Malaysian Government loan amounting to RM165,282,814.00 to equity through share ownership.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: The purpose of this loan being converted to equity is to reduce the financial burden of UDA considering that UDA's financial resources are limited, which is through existing funds that have been allocated for the company's operating expenses
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: and implement development projects for economic growth in the country in addition to safeguarding the interests of bumiputera in urban areas.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Although the financial position of UDA is strong,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: but based on the Accounting Regulation,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: revenue needs to be recorded
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: after the transaction is completed even though the payment has not yet been received.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Therefore, in accordance with the Accounting Regulation, UDA needs to record the sale of Bukit Bintang Plaza to Zurah Permai Sdn. Bhd. as much as RM354 million as revenue in their records.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: However, as of August 2022, UDA only received as much as RM228,300,000.00 with RM126,490,000.00 which should be paid in July 2022 has not yet been received.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: This has indirectly affected the position of UDA's cash flow in addition to affecting the UDA Group's five-year business plan plan,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: including the payment commitment that has been scheduled
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: which in turn has a negative impact on UDA's cash flow projections.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: The conversion of part of the loan balance of RM165,282,814.00 to equity will reduce the company's total liability and increase UDA's equity to RM500 million.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: This can indirectly improve gearing level with permission considering that currently UDA's equity is low compared to other real estate companies.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: With this increase in equity, it will enable UDA to obtain financing from other commercial banks to implement UDA projects.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: With the increase in UDA's equity to RM500 million, this will also reduce the debt to equity ratio with permission by 60.5 percent from 1.19 times to 0.47 times.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Therefore, in order to make a win-win situation concept decision
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: and enable UDA to continue operations
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: and further strengthen UDA's cash flow, the government agreed to convert the government's loan of RM165,282,814.00 to equity.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: This addition of capital of RM165,282,814.00 will increase UDA's capital to RM500 million in addition to giving UDA more space to increase property ownership by bumiputera.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, I would like to propose.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Well, Honorable Members, First Meeting, Second Term, 15th Parliament has lasted for 31 days from Monday 13 February
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: everyone

edus.text: to Tuesday 4 April 2023.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Thank God, this conference we are given the opportunity to fully implement the Opening Ceremony of the Term of Parliament,
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: everyone

edus.text: after three years of dealing with the risk of spreading COVID-19.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: everyone

edus.text: This meeting saw the Dewan Rakyat have approved the Motion to Uphold Love on the Royal Decree, Budget 2023 and a total of 12 bills and four proposals from the government.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: everyone

edus.text: In the meantime, this meeting has also shown that we have implemented various reforms in the affairs of the Dewan Rakyat.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Among the reforms are the `` Time of Minister's Questions '' or MQT for Tuesday has been answered by the Prime Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: everyone

edus.text: [ Applause ]
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: everyone

edus.text: At this meeting, it also shows that the number of `` Questions for Oral Answers '' often exceeds 10 oral questions.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: everyone

edus.text: This is followed by the matter of the Special Chamber
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: everyone

edus.text: which has given the opportunity to the Honorable Members as many as seven members from the government and six members from the opposition to temporarily chair the Special Chamber Meeting under Meeting Rule 16 ( 5 ).

edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Tuan Prabakaran a/l M Parameswaran ask the Prime Minister to state the total amount spent by the government on promotional and publicity work in publicizing the government's achievements through all mass media platforms including print media, digital media and also television media throughout the year since 2020 until now.
edus.speaker: Tuan Prabakaran a/l M Parameswaran [Batu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Please, Your Honor.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Tan Sri Yang di-Pertua, since 2020 until 2022
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Prabakaran a/l M Parameswaran [Batu]

edus.text: yes, the government has spent on promotion, at that time Pagoh and the government system of RM700 million.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Prabakaran a/l M Parameswaran [Batu]

edus.text: Ads, promotions, publicity.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Prabakaran a/l M Parameswaran [Batu]

edus.text: This means that almost more than RM500 million was spent during Pagoh and the rest by Bera.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Prabakaran a/l M Parameswaran [Batu]

edus.text: But Bera did not spend that much because there was an excess.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Prabakaran a/l M Parameswaran [Batu]

edus.text: That's why in 2023, I have no allocation, other than continuing the contract
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Prabakaran a/l M Parameswaran [Batu]

edus.text: made during Bera.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Prabakaran a/l M Parameswaran [Batu]

edus.text: So, RM700 million or approximately in the early stages of RM300 million a year.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Prabakaran a/l M Parameswaran [Batu]

edus.text: That for me, violates rules and governance and excessiveness.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Prabakaran a/l M Parameswaran [Batu]

edus.text: Therefore, I have ordered expenses from next year –
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Prabakaran a/l M Parameswaran [Batu]

edus.text: because this year I only took the existing contract, continuing what Bera had agreed to.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Prabakaran a/l M Parameswaran [Batu]

edus.text: Meaning, 2023 has no allocation and for 2024, I have ordered that the Ministry of Finance not approve more than RM100 million, instead of the amount of around RM300 million that was spent earlier.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Prabakaran a/l M Parameswaran [Batu]

edus.text: This, while we consider the explanation of the explanation necessary.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Prabakaran a/l M Parameswaran [Batu]

edus.text: I don't think the government should be burdened with additional advertisements and publicity for promotion, apart from the programs we go down to greet the people
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Prabakaran a/l M Parameswaran [Batu]

edus.text: and explain through mass media, including social media.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Prabakaran a/l M Parameswaran [Batu]

edus.text: Rock, please.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Tuan Prabakaran a/l M Parameswaran [Batu]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Prime Minister for the answer and it is really shocking, with permission, one year can spend RM300 million on publicity.
edus.speaker: Tuan Prabakaran a/l M Parameswaran [Batu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: if the communication allocation is reduced.
edus.speaker: Tuan Prabakaran a/l M Parameswaran [Batu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: What steps are the government taking to ensure that the people understand the government's policies, especially the Madani Economy and the Madani Budget?
edus.speaker: Tuan Prabakaran a/l M Parameswaran [Batu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Tuan Prabakaran a/l M Parameswaran [Batu]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Please Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Tan Sri Yang di-Pertua, while government programs include several new measures such as the Madani Economy, energy transition and also industrial and budget plans, of course, that needs to be explained to the people.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: We use the existing machinery and councils
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Okay, I invite Mr. Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj, Segamat.

edus.text: Tuan Yuneswaran A/L Ramaraj asked the Minister of Science, Technology and Innovation to state the commercialization and innovation ( C & I ) strategy that will be worked on in the delivery of public services that can support Malaysia to be among the top 30 countries in the Global Innovation Index by 2025.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]
addressees: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]

edus.text: Please Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]

edus.text: Thank you Tan Sri Yang di-Pertua,
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: thank you Segamat.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]

edus.text: For the information of Honorable Members, Malaysia's position remains at 36th out of 132 countries in the Global Innovation Index (GII) Report 2023.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]

edus.text: Despite this, the country's GII score has increased to 40.9 this year
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]

edus.text: compared to 38.7 in the previous year.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]

edus.text: Malaysia has also jumped to the second most innovative country position
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]

edus.text: after China among 36 upper middle-income groups, surpassing Bulgaria in the third position.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]

edus.text: Among ASEAN countries, Malaysia remains in second place after Singapore.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]

edus.text: Malaysia's performance improvement in terms of score is driven by various initiatives including the establishment of the Inter-Agency Committee on Competitive Monitoring-Global Innovation Index since 2021,
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]

edus.text: and also the GII Initiative Input Coordination Workshop was held last September,
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]

edus.text: which involved all ministries with the objective of collecting data that could contribute to the improvement of GII's performance.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]

edus.text: In the meantime, the Data-Global Innovation Index Model System has also been developed to provide a detailed analysis of the GII methodology, the development of scenarios to improve the country's position
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]

edus.text: and will act as a suitable monitoring method to be used in the decision-making process based on facts.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]

edus.text: In addition, to ensure that Malaysia is in the top 30 countries in GII by 2025 in line with the target set in the 12th Malaysia Plan Half-Term Review,
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]

edus.text: MOSTI will implement the following initiatives:
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]

edus.text: ( i ) intensify commercialization efforts with the strengthening and implementation of the government-funded intellectual property and copyright commercialization policy 2021 to 2025 so that ministries or government agencies will manage intellectual property ( IP ) systematically for the purpose of commercialization and further generate income and economic growth of the country; ( ii ) drafting the National Planet Health Action Plan to ensure that Malaysia is one step ahead in dealing with human health issues and related to nature, biodiversity and climate change which are also measured in GII;
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]

edus.text: ( iii ) the provision of local start-up system economic market information to help Bursa Malaysia in identifying potential start-ups to be listed on Bursa Malaysia;
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]

edus.text: and ( iv ) further encourage the involvement of private parties in RDICE ( R & D and innovation, commercialization and also ecosystem ) to increase business expenditure on R & D ( BERD ) through the implementation of Malaysia Science Endowment ( MSE ).
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]

edus.text: MSE is an alternative funding platform from various sources such as industry, international funds, waqf and donors.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]

edus.text: The Malaysian Academy of Sciences ( ASM ) as MSE's implementing agency is actively conducting tours in and outside the country
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]

edus.text: to attract interest to stakeholders such as large industrial companies, international associations and research institutions to establish cooperation with MSE.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]

edus.text: Good, Segamat.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]

edus.text: Thank you Tan Sri Speaker.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.speaker: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]
addressees: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]

edus.text: A pretty comprehensive answer
edus.speaker: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]
addressees: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]

edus.text: because – and I would also like to congratulate the Honorable Minister
edus.speaker: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]
addressees: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]

edus.text: and also MOSTI for an Innovathon Program that has given opportunities and platforms to entrepreneurs or professionals to present technological ideas
edus.speaker: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]
addressees: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]

edus.text: and that's why a pretty good program.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]
addressees: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]

edus.text: In line with that, I want to ask the question.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]
addressees: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]

edus.text: How can the reality TV show be used as a medium for short-term commercialization that can be matched with current needs, especially those involving the benefits of the people and minorities such as the disabled,
edus.speaker: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]
addressees: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]

edus.text: the elderly, the pregnant mother and others
edus.speaker: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]
addressees: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]

edus.text: and what other approaches will be focused on translating inspiration or innovation capital in practical forms that can be expanded in critical sectors, especially the health, education and public transport sectors, thank you.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]
addressees: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]

edus.text: Please Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]

edus.text: Thank you Tan Sri Yang di-Pertua.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Segamat.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]

edus.text: In fact, MOSTI is very proud of the technological creations and innovations that have been exhibited in this Innovathon
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]

edus.text: and the implementation of the Innovathon Program is in line with the MOSTI theme
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]

edus.text: which is `` Rising Science, Insuring Technology and also Madani Creation Daya ''.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]

edus.text: MOSTI is always committed to making R & D & C & I & E activities that include all layers of society and this Innovathon Program not only involves high technology developed by the industry
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]

edus.text: but also covers grassroots innovations born from the community.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]

edus.text: Regarding your honorable proposal, MOSTI agrees
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]

edus.text: and will improve the filling slot in the future, hopefully in the second season
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]

edus.text: by bringing interesting innovations from various government agencies through initiative platforms such as MCY, Malaysian Commercial Year, National Technology and Innovation Sandbox (NTIS)
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]

edus.text: and also the MySTI program.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]

edus.text: For your information, now in this Innovathon there are also many participants who are disabled, who are elderly and also children.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]

edus.text: But we will intensify the participation of this group.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]

edus.text: Following that, MOSTI in collaboration with various agencies has examined the technological creations and innovations that are the winners in the innovation
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]

edus.text: so that we identify whether, there is a need for the government, facilitate or intervene, intervention in the commercialization process of their products.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]

edus.text: That's it.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Tuan Yuneswaran a/l Ramaraj [Segamat]

edus.text: Kuala Terengganu.

edus.speaker: Datuk Ahmad Amzad bin Mohamed @ Hashim [Kuala Terengganu]

edus.text: If we look at the country's position in the Global Innovation Index,
edus.speaker: Datuk Ahmad Amzad bin Mohamed @ Hashim [Kuala Terengganu]
addressees: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]

edus.text: our position has always been between 33 and 37 for the past six years.
edus.speaker: Datuk Ahmad Amzad bin Mohamed @ Hashim [Kuala Terengganu]
addressees: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]

edus.text: We once rose in 2022, to 33rd position
edus.speaker: Datuk Ahmad Amzad bin Mohamed @ Hashim [Kuala Terengganu]
addressees: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]

edus.text: and still remain 36th.
edus.speaker: Datuk Ahmad Amzad bin Mohamed @ Hashim [Kuala Terengganu]
addressees: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]

edus.text: So my question is, our target in 2025 to get 30th position, I am a bit worried
edus.speaker: Datuk Ahmad Amzad bin Mohamed @ Hashim [Kuala Terengganu]
addressees: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]

edus.text: because I see in terms of the allocated budget, it is still small for example for MIMOS together with MYSA together with drones, together with robotics, RM10 million.
edus.speaker: Datuk Ahmad Amzad bin Mohamed @ Hashim [Kuala Terengganu]
addressees: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]

edus.text: While this is a large sector in the largest manufacturing sector.
edus.speaker: Datuk Ahmad Amzad bin Mohamed @ Hashim [Kuala Terengganu]
addressees: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]

edus.text: So, what about R & D contributions to GERD and BERD which are still low in the country.
edus.speaker: Datuk Ahmad Amzad bin Mohamed @ Hashim [Kuala Terengganu]
addressees: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]

edus.text: I request the ministry to provide an explanation of how we want to improve the role of the private sector, the industry to increase their contribution in R & D in the country

addressees: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]

edus.text: thus helping to improve Malaysia's position in the innovation industry.

edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Datuk Ahmad Amzad bin Mohamed @ Hashim [Kuala Terengganu]

edus.text: In fact, the previous country was between 33 and 36
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Datuk Ahmad Amzad bin Mohamed @ Hashim [Kuala Terengganu]

edus.text: and it can be said that it is a very difficult task for us to reach a position of 30 and above by 2025.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Datuk Ahmad Amzad bin Mohamed @ Hashim [Kuala Terengganu]

edus.text: But there are many government efforts to move in that direction.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Datuk Ahmad Amzad bin Mohamed @ Hashim [Kuala Terengganu]

edus.text: The first thing is, for the information of the Honorable with this honorable House, for R & D funds, this year 2023 is allocated as much as RM428 million for R & D and next year 2024, the government has already allocated as much as RM510 million which is a surge of approximately 20 percent.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Datuk Ahmad Amzad bin Mohamed @ Hashim [Kuala Terengganu]

edus.text: This is one of the efforts.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Datuk Ahmad Amzad bin Mohamed @ Hashim [Kuala Terengganu]

edus.text: The second, our second effort is to intensify BERD, business expenditure in this R & D by making matching grants with permission through the Malaysia Science Endowment (MSE).
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Datuk Ahmad Amzad bin Mohamed @ Hashim [Kuala Terengganu]

edus.text: Malaysia Science Endowment, Akademi Sains Malaysia, which is the implementation of this MSE, is currently conducting tours in and out of the country to help or attract investors to enter or venture into this R & D field
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Datuk Ahmad Amzad bin Mohamed @ Hashim [Kuala Terengganu]

edus.text: so that it can help us raise this BERD,
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Datuk Ahmad Amzad bin Mohamed @ Hashim [Kuala Terengganu]

edus.text: because in the last three years most of our businesses have not been involved in R & D.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Datuk Ahmad Amzad bin Mohamed @ Hashim [Kuala Terengganu]

edus.text: They look more at survivors with permission,
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Datuk Ahmad Amzad bin Mohamed @ Hashim [Kuala Terengganu]

edus.text: but now that we are post-pandemic, there will be more industries that will be involved in these R & D activities with government facilities such as MSE and others.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Datuk Ahmad Amzad bin Mohamed @ Hashim [Kuala Terengganu]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sains dan Teknologi [Tuan Chang Lih Kang]
addressees: Datuk Ahmad Amzad bin Mohamed @ Hashim [Kuala Terengganu]

edus.text: Okay, now I invite Mr. Haji Muhammad Islahuddin bin Abas, Mersing.

edus.text: Tuan Haji Muhammad Islahuddin bin Abas asked the Minister of Youth and Sports to state whether the ministry will use Zeon Zoysia field in other stadiums besides Bukit Jalil National Stadium
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Muhammad Islahuddin bin Abas [Mersing]
addressees: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]

edus.text: since the quality of the field is proven to be of high quality and international standard.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Muhammad Islahuddin bin Abas [Mersing]
addressees: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]

edus.text: asked the Minister of Youth and Sports to state
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Muhammad Islahuddin bin Abas [Mersing]
addressees: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]

edus.text: whether the ministry will use Zeon Zoysia field in other stadiums besides Bukit Jalil National Stadium
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Muhammad Islahuddin bin Abas [Mersing]
addressees: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]

edus.text: since the quality of the field is proven to be of high quality and international standard.
edus.speaker: Tuan Haji Muhammad Islahuddin bin Abas [Mersing]
addressees: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]

edus.text: Please Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Mersing.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Haji Muhammad Islahuddin bin Abas [Mersing]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, before that allow me to welcome the Kuala Lumpur City Hall team, Segambut division for the presence in the Dewan Rakyat this morning.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: I would like to bring this honorable House to remember the concern of His Majesty, Major General Tunku Ismail ibni Sultan Ibrahim who was willing to pollute him to Bukit Jalil National Stadium in March last year.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Haji Muhammad Islahuddin bin Abas [Mersing]

edus.text: His Majesty Tunku has also agreed to grant Zeon Zoysia grass as an improvement of the Bukit Jalil National Stadium field due to the condition of the field at that time being very bad
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Haji Muhammad Islahuddin bin Abas [Mersing]

edus.text: because it was stagnant by water.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Haji Muhammad Islahuddin bin Abas [Mersing]

edus.text: One of the reasons is because the last time the drainage and irrigation system was changed was in 2013.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Haji Muhammad Islahuddin bin Abas [Mersing]

edus.text: While the last time the grass was changed cow grass with permission was in 2015.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Haji Muhammad Islahuddin bin Abas [Mersing]

edus.text: The conversion to Zeon Zoysia grass is also based on the best practices of countries in Southeast Asia,
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Haji Muhammad Islahuddin bin Abas [Mersing]

edus.text: including Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia that have already used Zeon Zoysia grass.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Haji Muhammad Islahuddin bin Abas [Mersing]

edus.text: As the Honorable Member is well aware, Zeon Zoysia grass is one of the high-quality and durable grass to be planted in football fields.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Haji Muhammad Islahuddin bin Abas [Mersing]

edus.text: The Ministry of Youth and Sports has suggested that stadiums in all states consider the use of Zeon Zoysia grass or the equivalent of it.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Haji Muhammad Islahuddin bin Abas [Mersing]

edus.text: However, it is subject to the state government
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Haji Muhammad Islahuddin bin Abas [Mersing]

edus.text: because they need to study and examine first in terms of costs and long-term maintenance for the cultivation of the grass.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Haji Muhammad Islahuddin bin Abas [Mersing]

edus.text: Until now, only the state of Sarawak has expressed agreement to use this Zeon Zoysia grass.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Haji Muhammad Islahuddin bin Abas [Mersing]

edus.text: The states that do not agree are Terengganu, the Federal Territory and Pahang who want to maintain the use of existing grass.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Haji Muhammad Islahuddin bin Abas [Mersing]

edus.text: While other states still need an extension of time to make decisions
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Haji Muhammad Islahuddin bin Abas [Mersing]

edus.text: until they are really confident that the cost and maintenance of the grass is not burdensome for the long term.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Haji Muhammad Islahuddin bin Abas [Mersing]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Haji Muhammad Islahuddin bin Abas [Mersing]

addressees: Tuan Haji Muhammad Islahuddin bin Abas [Mersing]

addressees: Tuan Haji Muhammad Islahuddin bin Abas [Mersing]

addressees: Tuan Haji Muhammad Islahuddin bin Abas [Mersing]

edus.text: because each stadium selected by them has different status conditions.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Haji Muhammad Islahuddin bin Abas [Mersing]

edus.text: I give an example of maybe one state A, they just need to upgrade the drainage system.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Haji Muhammad Islahuddin bin Abas [Mersing]

edus.text: For B, maybe they just need to upgrade the soil near there.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Haji Muhammad Islahuddin bin Abas [Mersing]

edus.text: Therefore, the offer we give is for the cost of grass only and they don't say they 're not interested.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Haji Muhammad Islahuddin bin Abas [Mersing]

edus.text: Most states say they want to wait first to study in terms of maintenance costs every month,

addressees: Tuan Haji Muhammad Islahuddin bin Abas [Mersing]

addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: outside is a demonstration.
edus.speaker: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: In the House of Representatives there is legislatif strength as in Spain, in Columbia, in Ireland ...
edus.speaker: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: I have already said,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]

edus.text: if the Honorable Machang and Arau are not satisfied,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]

edus.text: you can make a proposal.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]

edus.text: If he pushes again, pushes, pushes.
edus.speaker: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: That's the Speaker's decision.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]

edus.text: Your Honor often rejects proposals ...
edus.speaker: Dato’ Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: So, please sit down.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Dato’ Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]
Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]

edus.text: Your Honor, we want to make this proposal after he bombs the hospital.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Yes.
edus.speaker: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: So, during the time of the Minister, Prime Minister and also the Deputy Prime Minister for information,
edus.speaker: Dato’ Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: the hospital has not been bombed.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: This is bombed by the hospital.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Your Honor, this is the Information Council and not the government's stance.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Yes, that's correct.
edus.speaker: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: We want the position of the Malaysian Government, the people of Malaysia in relation to Palestine.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: I already said,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Dato’ Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]

edus.text: if Arau is not satisfied,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Dato’ Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]

edus.text: make a proposal.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Dato’ Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]

edus.text: I don't want to say
edus.speaker: Dato’ Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: so I want to ask the government to make a proposal.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Make a motion to the Honorable Tan Sri Speaker.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Dato’ Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]

edus.text: The explanation from the Prime Minister and the Deputy Prime Minister is just an explanation,
edus.speaker: Dato’ Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: but we do not ask us to give any views or bring a motion.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Dear Arau, Machang please sit down.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Dato’ Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]
Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]

edus.text: Yes, so thank you Speaker.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Thank you Speaker.
edus.speaker: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: I ask the Speaker to please convey this great and terrible information from us, to the government, thank you.
edus.speaker: Dato’ Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
